mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_AVAILABLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_FROZEN' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS frozen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingSettle, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS merchantCount FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN ledger_account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' AND a.owner_id = m.id AND a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') AND a.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ledger_balance b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.account_id = a.id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(a.currency, m.default_currency) = #{currency}
SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled FROM merchant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

choose.when: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PAY' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.pay_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.updated_at AS eventAt, o.status_reason AS reason FROM pay_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW' UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYOUT' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.payout_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.updated_at AS eventAt, COALESCE(o.status_reason, o.fail_msg) AS reason FROM payout_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW' ) todos ORDER BY eventAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PAY' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.pay_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.merchant_notify_at AS eventAt, o.status_reason AS reason FROM pay_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.merchant_notify_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYOUT' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.payout_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.merchant_notify_at AS eventAt, COALESCE(o.status_reason, o.fail_msg) AS reason FROM payout_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.merchant_notify_status = 'FAILED' ) todos ORDER BY eventAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'PAY' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.pay_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.settle_amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.settle_release_at AS eventAt, o.status_reason AS reason FROM pay_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.status = 'SUCCESS' AND o.settle_status = 'PENDING' AND o.settle_release_at IS NOT NULL AND o.settle_release_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY eventAt ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'PAY' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.pay_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.updated_at AS eventAt, o.status_reason AS reason FROM pay_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY eventAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'PAYOUT' AS bizType, o.id AS orderId, o.payout_order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, o.amount AS amount, o.currency AS currency, o.status AS status, o.updated_at AS eventAt, COALESCE(o.status_reason, o.fail_msg) AS reason FROM payout_order o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND m.id = o.merchant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.currency = #{currency} AND o.status IN ('CREATED', 'FROZEN', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY eventAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
